def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    # Check shape and dimensions
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
    
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if n_candidates == 0 or future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must not be empty")
    
    # Check finiteness and nonpositivity
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    
    # Compute future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    # weight_sum > 0 because t=0 gives weight=1
    weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
    
    # Compute weighted negative log probability losses
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)          # shape (n_candidates,)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    
    # Margins
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margins >= tau_filter
    
    return keep_mask, margins
